value: NASA HLS HLSL30 / HLSS30 v2.0 (LP DAAC), GDAL HTTP range reads
One scene per region per month; L30 preferred, S30 used when no L30 exists
31 x 31 pixels at 30 m around the region coordinate
NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red); NDMI = (NIR - SWIR1) / (NIR + SWIR1)
L30 red B04 / NIR B05 / SWIR1 B06; S30 red B04 / NIR B8A / SWIR1 B11; Fmask for quality
Fmask bits 0-5 excluded, aerosol bits 6-7 = 3 excluded, zero denominators rejected
Surface reflectance scaled by 0.0001 before indexing
Indices are indicators, not direct measurements of soil moisture, nutrients or disease.
Usable cloud-free observations are not guaranteed every month; coverage is reported per row.
Imagery is not stored - only the sampled statistics.
